13. Firm has to submit Earnest Money Deposit as Bid security of Rs. 3,09,937/- alon g with the Tender in favor of “CHIEF GENERAL MANAGER, ORDNANCE FACTORY KHA MARIA, JABALPUR“ except Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) having UAM number a s defined in MSE Procurement Policy issued by Department of Micro, Small and Mediu m Enterprises (MSME) or are registered with the Central Purchase Organization or the concerned Ministry or Department (including OFs) or Start-ups as recognized by Dep artment of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP), irrespective of the store for which t hey are registered. Performance Security deposit is to be submitted by the supplier as per TE terms & conditions if contract value (including all taxes) will be more than 5 Lakhs (within 3 0 days from the date of awarding of contract). PSD has to be submitted online throug h SB Collect portal (link- “https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm” 15. Unloading/Loading of dispatched material will be done by Store Section/OFK’s hir ed labourers. The charges of the same will be deducted @ Rs 220.00 / ton from the r egular bills of firm. NOTE: Bidders may please note that the GEM portal captures & shows the I P addresses used by the Buyer and the Bidder(s)/Seller(s). The received bid s having matching/common IP address with either Bidder(s)/Seller(s) or Buy er, shall be out rightly rejected & shall not be considered for further evaluat ion. N.B. Eligible Bidders are requested to go through the QAP/Specification and Tender T erms & Conditions and should satisfy themselves before participating in the tender.
